description: Read the bytes back from a recording of a sound made by encode_audio, the audio-v2 format or the earlier v1: a PCM16 WAV at 44100 or 48000 Hz, mono or stereo, at most 40 seconds, checked by its checksum. Give storage_id for a WAV of at most 4 MiB uploaded through REST Storage first, since recordings exceed the inline MCP request limit; REST accepts files up to 8 MiB. storage_id must name an ordinary 24-hour file, without a max_downloads limit. Answers data_base64, byte_length and text when the bytes are valid UTF-8. This decodes data sent as sound, not speech. The decoded result is not stored, and stored input keeps its original lifetime. No API key, no account and no sign up.

mode.description: auto tries all three bands within one shared time limit, and the earlier v1 format only in audible. Pick audible, high or ultrasound when known.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

name: decode_audio
title: Decode data from sound
